page.layout: Running head at top: "DE GRATITVDINE." with page number "156" at top left. Below, two parallel columns of text (left column wide, right column narrower). Below the columns, one full-width passage of text. No margin notes. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: nouat nos quoque fuo Spiritu ad imaginem fui, vt tantis beneficijs affecti, in omni vita nos erga Deum gratos declaremus a, & ipfe per nos celebretur b. De inde vt nos quoque ex fructibus, de fua quifque fide certi fimus c. Poftremò, vt vitæ noftræ integritate alios Chrifto lucrifaciamus d.

rationes Dei, vt fiftatis corpora vestra hostiam viua, fanctam, acceptam Deo, rationalem illum cultum vestrum: Et ne configuremini feculo isti, fed transformemini per renouationem mentis vestræ, ad hoc vt probetis quæ fit voluntas Dei, bona illa, accepta & perfecta.

· 1. Pet. 2. v. 5. Ipsi quoque velut viui lapides, ædificemini domus spiritualis, sacerdotium sanctum, ad offerendum spirituales hostias, acceptas Deo per Iesum Christum. Item v. 9. 10. Vos autem genus electum, regale sacerdotium, gens sancta, populus, quem sibi Deus vt proprium vendicat: vt virtutes prædicetis illius qui vos vocauit è tenebris in admirabilem suam lucem. Qui quondam eratis non populus, nunc autem populus Dei: qui non consecuti misericordiam, nunc estis misericordiâ consecuti.

page.notes: Marginal reference marks a, b, c, d in the text; the Latin is set in two columns, the right column with a marginal reference "1. Pet. 2. v. 5." and "1. Cor. 6." below. Some words are uncertain in the right column, notably "vestra" and "hostiam" read as printed; reading of small reference marks approximate.
